description: Get native + ERC-20 token balances for one address across many of the 23 EVM chains in a SINGLE call — including young chains (Robinhood, Plasma, Ink) that Alchemy/Moralis omit. With an x402 wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY) this is paid per request (~$0.0003/chain); otherwise it uses the free public tier.

chains.description: Chains to include — slug, name, or chain ID; defaults to all 23

discover.description: Auto-discover the ERC-20 tokens the address holds via Transfer logs. Needs an x402 wallet (heavy method). Comprehensive on young chains; large chains cap the scan — narrow with fromBlock.

fromBlock.description: Start block for discovery (hex or 'earliest'); narrow the window on high-history chains

includeDust.description: Discovery only: keep dust balances below 1e-9 units. Default false.

includeSpam.description: Discovery only: keep tokens with no DefiLlama price (likely spam/airdrops) on price-covered chains. Default false.

minUsd.description: Discovery only: drop discovered tokens worth less than this USD value on price-covered chains (default 0.01, filters near-worthless spam). Set 0 to keep any priced token.

tokens.description: ERC-20 contract addresses per chain, e.g. { base: ['0x833589…'] }

name: get_multichain_balances
